lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Um...

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: I get that taking bold new steps and forging a path to a new world is exciting,

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: but is this really the right move?

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: Of course!

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: Things have always panned out for us before.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: It's not us that I'm worried about.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: It's Ark that concerns me.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: What about the Ark?
There are still loads of issues left unresolved.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Exactly.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: You know, what's really getting under my skin is Dorothy.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Can you believe she's snagged herself a dedicated channel on the Ark?

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Who knows what she'll do with it?

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: Maybe she just wants to do some live streams or something?

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: I'm sure there's a demand to see ladies of her stature on screen.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: I suppose so.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Maybe that'd be a big hit,

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: but something tells me she's got her sights on something bigger.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: Something bigger?

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: Like being super duper dignified?

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Do you really think that's what I'm getting at, you dolt?

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: This is Dorothy we're talking about, so it should be fine.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: For now, at least.
I think so too.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: What makes you so sure?

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Because she might need some time to calm her emotions

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: and...
I don't think she'll be overly aggressive.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Me neither.
I don't know what her intentions are, but she'll almost certainly be proceeding with caution.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Her plan may well take more time than we expect it to.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: I dunno, but this whole thing seems like your typical action movie plot, ya know?

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: The heroes underestimate the villain, and before you know it, things blow up in their faces.
If it comes to that, we'll be able to stop her.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: After all, she's not completely unreasonable.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Can I ask you two something?

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Is there something

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: you guys are keeping from us?
No.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: So, why are you guys so perfectly in sync, huh?
That's just how I feel about the issue.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Likewise.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Nah, there's definitely something going on between you two.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: Isn't it the telepathy that develops when you've been hanging out for ages?

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: I've been around just as long, and I ain't got no telepathic powers!
